Description: Dual 1-Form-A/B solid-state relay, used as SPDT (350 V, 150 mA); 8/7 = NC to Micra, 6/5 = NO to remote
Notes: THT on purpose: Panasonic AQW612EH drops in if the NC/NO mapping proves wrong (then R2-R5 -> 270R). Meter 8-7 continuity unpowered before fab.

Description: 1-Form-A PhotoMOS relay (60 V, 550 mA, 3 mA max LED); drives Micra W/B from GPIO52
Notes: AQY212EHA is the SMD variant - board wants the DIP.

Description: Opto-isolator, transistor output (5 kV, CTR >= 50%); isolates the remote SENSE GPIO from the paddle wire: P1 switches the LED (from 5V via R6), the transistor pulls SENSE low (closed = low, unchanged firmware)
Notes: Rev 0.7/0.8 insurance: contacts off the SENSE node, fails open. Any PC817-class DIP-4 opto, rank irrelevant (>= 50% CTR); THT to match the board.

Description: JST PH 2.0 mm 5-pos side-entry header; Apollo (GND_R/5V/DRIVE/SENSE/CTRL)
Notes: Same drills as vertical B5B-PH-K if side-entry is out of stock.

Description: JST PH 2.0 mm 4-pos side-entry header; machine (P1/P2/W/B)
Notes: Same drills as vertical B4B-PH-K if side-entry is out of stock.

Description: USB 2.0 Type-C receptacle, through-hole; 5 V power in only (VBUS -> J1 5V, GND -> GND_R)
Notes: Power only: D+/D-/SBU unused. R9/R10 (5k1 Rd on CC1/CC2) make it a default-5 V sink so any USB-C source

Description: Thick film resistor 330 ohm 1% 0.25 W; R1 = U1 LED, R2-R5 = U2/U3 LEDs
Notes: Switch to 270R if AQW612EH is fitted.

Description: Thick film resistor 560 ohm 1% 0.25 W; U4 LED series resistor from 5V (~6.8 mA)
Notes: Rev 0.7: was 1k in series with SENSE (rev 0.6). Any 470R-680R works: PC817 CTR >= 50% at 5 mA covers R7 + the pad pull-up with margin.

Description: Thick film resistor 10 kohm 1% 0.25 W; SENSE pull-up (with D1)
Thick film resistor 2.2 kohm 1% 0.25 W; LED1 current limit
Small-signal diode; pull-up steering for R7
Notes: PCB pads are D_1206; 1N4148W is SOD-123 and sits on them - check fit or pick a 1206-bodied diode.

Description: Small-signal diode anti-parallel to U4's LED: gives a positive charge on P1 a forward path to 5V through R6 instead of the LED's reverse breakdown
Notes: Rev 0.7. Same footprint caveat as D1.

Description: MLCC 100 nF X7R 50 V; SENSE-to-GND_R hold-up at J1 - the SENSE node (the cable to the remote plus its pad, ~100 pF) becomes 1000x harder to lift past the rail; with R7 and the pad's own pull-up it is the RC that steadies the remote's input
Notes: Rev 0.8. Any 100 nF X7R, 25 V or more, 1206 (0805 fits the pads too).

Description: ESD protection diode, 5 V working voltage, <1 uA leakage, 8 kV contact; SENSE to GND_R at J1 - clamps a static discharge on the cable or the plug before the remote's input pad sees it (C1 covers the slow stuff; this is the fast stuff)
Notes: Rev 0.8. Unidirectional: cathode (pin 1, band) on SENSE, anode on GND_R. Any 5 V ESD diode in SOD-323 works; do NOT use a 3.3 V TVS (leaks at the pin's idle level).

Description: Green indicator LED, lit while CTRL is high
Thick film resistor 5.1 kohm 1% 0.25 W; USB-C CC1/CC2 Rd pull-downs to GND_R
Notes: One per CC pin - never share one resistor between CC1 and CC2.

Description: PTC resettable fuse, 1.5 A hold / 3.0 A trip, 12 V, 1812; in series with USB-C VBUS before J1 5V
Notes: Bourns MF-MSMF150-2 is EOL. Alternate: TE MINISMDC150F-2 (6 V, same pads). Hold current derates roughly 1%/degC above 25 C (about 0.9 A at 85 C). Measured load: 0.6 A battery-less, 1.0 A with a battery charging (X-8, 2026-10-02) - fine at room temperature, but a charging unit in a hot spot approaches the derated hold; consider 2 A (e.g. 1812L200) if that case matters.
